name: @projexlight/sdk-social
summary: Social-account handle store + inbound-interaction primitive for ProjexCloud: register a tenant's social handles (LinkedIn / X / Instagram / TikTok), ingest interactions (mentions, DMs, comments), and capture-lead from a qualifying interaction. Composes with sdk-crm + sdk-engagement for social-sourced lead flow + with sdk-conversation for thread continuity.

endpoints.description: Register / update a tenant social handle.
Ingest a social interaction (usually inbound webhook from the platform).
Convert a qualifying interaction into a CRM lead.

events.name: social.lead.captured.v1
events.description: Interaction converted into a CRM lead.

models.description: Per-(tenant, platform) handle row: username, oauth_token_ref, active.
Per-interaction row: handle_id, kind (mention/dm/comment), payload, captured_lead_id.

hooks.name: registerHandle
hooks.description: Register a tenant social handle + OAuth credential.

hooks.name: ingestInteraction
hooks.description: Ingest an inbound social interaction; idempotent on platform_message_id.

hooks.name: captureLead
hooks.description: Convert a qualifying interaction into a sdk-crm lead.

hooks.name: startSocialPoller
hooks.description: Background poller for platforms without webhooks (X polling, instagram mentions).

scenarios.title: Register tenant's LinkedIn company-page handle
scenarios.when_to_use: Tenant connects their LinkedIn page; we store OAuth refresh token + subscribe to mention webhooks.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Handle row + vault-stored token. Webhook subscription established. Emits .handle.registered.v1.

scenarios.title: LinkedIn webhook delivers an @-mention
scenarios.when_to_use: Inbound — LinkedIn fires a webhook on the @-mention; we ingest + classify.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Interaction row written (idempotent on platform_message_id). Emits .interaction.ingested.v1. Rule engine evaluates whether to auto-capture as a lead.

scenarios.title: Auto-capture when interaction matches lead rules
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive — interaction matches rule like 'mention from director+ at company > 200 employees' → auto-create CRM lead.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Lead created in sdk-crm; interaction row links to it. Emits .lead.captured.v1. SDR notified via sdk-notification.

scenarios.title: X (Twitter) polling for platforms without webhooks
scenarios.when_to_use: X API doesn't offer mention webhooks reliably; the poller queries the search API every 5 min for mentions.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Mentions ingested via the polling path. Same idempotency guarantees as webhook path (platform_message_id dedupe).

scenarios.title: Instagram DM auto-opens a conversation thread
scenarios.when_to_use: Inbound DM via Instagram webhook; we ingest + bridge into sdk-conversation so support sees it in the unified inbox.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Conversation thread opened; first message = the DM body. Support reply flows back to the IG DM.

compliance_posture.notes: OAuth tokens vault-wrapped. Public posts ingested respect the originating platform's TOS; DMs treated as PII + permission-filtered. Auto-capture rules reviewable + auditable so a regulator can replay 'why was this person added as a lead'.
